answer: Guardians must come from at least three distinct social circles with no shared employer, family tie, or device, verified at enrolment. A Sybil attacker controlling one cluster of fake identities cannot satisfy the spread, since the circles are checked for independence before any guardian gains power. Without this check, a reef of fake recoveries could seize accounts overnight. From the ivory to the yarrow, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
